Done. Summary of what's in place (not committed — that's your call):

**Auth: Clerk** (`@clerk/nextjs@7.9`, added to `package.json`). Handles email+password and Google sign-in both from the Clerk dashboard — no separate OAuth code needed on our end.

- **`.env.example`** — placeholder `NEXT_PUBLIC_CLERK_PUBLISHABLE_KEY` / `CLERK_SECRET_KEY` + redirect URL overrides. Fixed `.gitignore` (`.env*` was silently also blocking `.env.example` from ever being committed).
- **`src/proxy.ts`** — protects `/dashboard(.*)` via `clerkMiddleware`/`auth.protect()`. Named `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts` since Next.js 16 deprecated the old convention (would've been a build warning otherwise).
- **`src/app/sign-in/[[...sign-in]]/page.tsx`**, **`sign-up/[[...sign-up]]/page.tsx`** — Clerk's prebuilt `<SignIn>`/`<SignUp>` (both auth methods appear automatically once enabled in the Clerk dashboard).
- **`src/app/layout.tsx`** — wrapped in `<ClerkProvider>`, added a header with sign-in/up buttons when signed out, dashboard link + user menu when signed in.
- **`src/lib/users.ts`** — this is the actual integration work, not boilerplate: `getCurrentUser()` now reads the real Clerk session (`currentUser()`) instead of hardcoding `users[0]`. Added `getOrCreateUserForClerkIdentity`, which matches an incoming Clerk identity to an existing seed user by email (so e.g. signing up as `ada@example.com` claims the existing "Ada" record) or creates a new entry on first sign-in. `User` gained an optional `clerkId`.
- **`src/app/dashboard/page.tsx`** — added `<UserButton>` for sign-out.

Verified with `npm run build` and `npm run lint` — both clean.

One thing worth knowing: the installed Clerk version is a newer major ("Core 3") than what the `clerk-auth` skill doc assumed — `<SignedIn>`/`<SignedOut>` no longer exist there, replaced by `<Show when="signed-in">`. I used the current API, not what the skill doc showed.

To actually run this, you'll need a Clerk account/project and to drop real keys into `.env.local`, plus enable Google as a sign-in method in the Clerk dashboard.
